stack.rationale: Stated by client — seamless Next.js integration, automatic deployments, edge functions support
Stated by client — property photos uploaded by admin, admin selects which photos appear in each section
Already set up in existing codebase, supports SSR and static generation
Already configured, used in design reference for utility-first styling
Used in design reference for smooth scroll and scroll-triggered animations
Already in dependencies, alternative to GSAP for React-native animations
Already configured, serverless PostgreSQL with type-safe queries for property catalog and stats

architectureNotes.heading: Admin Dashboard with Static Auth
architectureNotes.body: Admin accesses dashboard using static credentials stored in environment variables. No OAuth or user management system needed. Simple HTTP Basic Auth or custom login comparing against env vars. Session via signed cookies.

architectureNotes.heading: Property Photo Management
architectureNotes.body: Admin uploads property photos to Vercel Blob via admin dashboard. Each property can have multiple photos. Admin designates which photo appears in Hero, Property Showcase, and other sections. Store photo URLs and section assignments in database.

architectureNotes.heading: Stats Management
architectureNotes.body: Stats (properties sold, clients, years, success rate) stored in database and editable via admin dashboard. Allows marketing team to update achievements without code changes. Single row table or key-value config.

architectureNotes.heading: Incremental Static Regeneration for Properties
architectureNotes.body: Use Next.js ISR to cache property listings with revalidation interval. Properties don't change frequently, so 1-hour revalidation is acceptable. Keeps database load low while ensuring fresh data.

architectureNotes.heading: Lead Capture: Mailto + WhatsApp Only
architectureNotes.body: No backend form processing needed. Contact form uses mailto: for email and WhatsApp deep links (wa.me/62xxx) for direct messaging. No lead storage in database. Simplicity over tracking for MVP.

architectureNotes.heading: Bank Partner Logo Assets
architectureNotes.body: Client has 9 bank partners (BNI, BJB, BTN, BRI, BCA, BPR, BPR HIK, BWS/Bank Woori Saudara, Bank Sampoerna). Need to source official logos and apply greyscale filter for visual consistency in the marquee. Consider SVG format for crisp rendering at any size.

architectureNotes.heading: Catalog Page Implementation
architectureNotes.body: Design now ready. Grid layout with property cards, filter sidebar or top bar for type (jual/sewa), price range, and location. Consider URL-based filter state for shareable links. ISR with on-demand revalidation when admin updates properties.

architectureNotes.heading: Property Detail Page Implementation
architectureNotes.body: Design now ready. Photo gallery with lightbox, property specs grid, description section, and sticky contact CTA. Generate static pages for all properties at build time with ISR. Include structured data (JSON-LD) for SEO.

risks.text: GSAP ScrollTrigger + Lenis smooth scroll may cause scroll position mismatch errors during development
Static env-based admin auth is less secure than OAuth — suitable only for internal tools with trusted users
Bank logo sourcing may require brand guideline compliance checks for each institution

openDecisions.text: Replace GSAP with Framer Motion for smaller bundle, or keep GSAP for mature ScrollTrigger API?
